The words of an attachment, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== attachment.blueprint
--- written
blueprint: w
uses:
    other:
        blueprint: other
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

uses:
  other:
    blueprint: other

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
uses:
    other:
        blueprint: [x]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 3:5
an attachment needs `blueprint: <name>`

=== attachment.with
--- written
blueprint: w
uses:
    other:
        blueprint: other
        with: {word: seen}
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- laid
blueprint: w

uses:
  other:
    blueprint: other
    with: { word: seen }

steps:
  a: { do: noop }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
uses:
    other:
        blueprint: other
        with: [a]
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
--- refused 5:15
`with` must be a mapping, found a list
